work.title: Diptych with Footballs and Targets
work.description: Two framed collage panels presented as a diptych, each densely layered with concentric target rings, vinyl records, and American football forms. Bold vertical red and yellow stripes anchor the left panel while the right panel features a large circular arc and fabric lettering against a white ground.
work.composition: Diptych of two densely layered panels
